Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: an instance you solve costs 1 for each wrong submission and 1 for
each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

{
 "path": "/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-hermes-luna6-medium-rnd0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u046/system/state/workspace/programs/task-2864706a.py",
 "content": "def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 2]
    # The pair of markers sharing a row defines the horizontal trunk.
    rows = {}
    for r, c in points:
        rows.setdefault(r, []).append(c)
    trunk_row = next((r for r, cols in rows.items() if len(cols) >= 2), None)
    if trunk_row is None:
        return out
    anchors = rows[trunk_row]
    left, right = min(anchors), max(anchors)
    for c in range(left + 1, right):
        if out[trunk_row][c] == 0:
            out[trunk_row][c] = 3
    for r, c in points:
        if r == trunk_row:
            continue
        start, end = sorted((r, trunk_row))
        for rr in range(start + 1, end):
            if out[rr][c] == 0:
                out[rr][c] = 3
    return out

if __name__ == '__main__':
    demo = [[0]*13 for _ in range(19)]
    for r,c in [(3,8),(6,4),(6,12),(9,10),(11,7)]: demo[r][c]=2
    result = transform(demo)
    assert result[4][8] == result[5][8] == 3
    assert result[6][5] == result[6][11] == 3
    assert result[7][7] == result[10][7] == 3
    assert result[7][10] == result[8][10] == 3
    test = [[0]*17 for _ in range(14)]
    for r,c in [(3,6),(6,4),(8,1),(8,12),(10,10),(12,8)]: test[r][c]=2
    ans = transform(test)
    print(ans)
    assert len(ans) == 14 and all(len(row) == 17 for row in ans)
    assert ans[8][2] == ans[8][11] == 3
    assert ans[4][6] == ans[7][6] == 3
    assert ans[9][10] == 3 and ans[11][8] == 3
    print('demo-pattern and test checks passed')

transform.__module__ = 'task-2864706a'

# Also expose the requested transform for import; the checks above run only as a script.
if __name__ != '__main__':
    pass

# Print-free production transform; callers should invoke transform(grid).
